desc:
Sporting clays shooters looking to level up and make serious improvements to their game have come to the right place. The new Citori 825 Pro Sporting has the features, handling, and durability help you find your way to the top step of the podium.
The Citori 825 Pro Sporting offers "Pro" level adjustment with the Pro Balance System – a set of adjustable weights in the stock that allows shooters to customize the balance of their gun to change swing dynamics and reduce felt recoil. The Pro Fit Adjustable Comb provides even more customization, using simple one bolt adjustment to personalize both cast and drop measurements to have you looking straight down the wide rib.
